system: civil law system that includes features of French civil law and Russian Federation laws

constitution.history: previous 1993, 2007, 2010; latest approved by referendum in 2021
constitution.amend: proposed as a draft law by the majority of the Supreme Council membership or by petition of 300,000 voters; passage requires at least two-thirds majority vote of the Council membership in each of at least three readings of the draft two months apart; the draft may be submitted to a referendum if approved by two thirds of the Council membership; adoption requires the signature of the president

courts.highest: Supreme Court (consists of 25 judges); Constitutional Chamber of the Supreme Court (consists of the chairperson, deputy chairperson, and 9 judges)
courts.judges: Supreme Court and Constitutional Court judges appointed by the Supreme Council on the recommendation of the president; Supreme Court judges serve for 10 years, Constitutional Court judges serve for 15 years; mandatory retirement at age 70 for judges of both courts
courts.lower: Higher Court of Arbitration; oblast (provincial) and city courts

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of Kyrgyzstan
citizenship.dual: yes, but only if a mutual treaty on dual citizenship is in force

world: has not submitted an ICJ jurisdiction declaration; non-party state to the ICCt
